item.title: Murmurly 2.0.0
item.description:
Murmurly 2.0

The name, the account, the window and the cleanup all changed this month; this release rounds it off, so it gets the number.

What's new since Murmur

  • Murmurly, with an account. Sign in with Google once; after that it works offline. What it sends home afterwards is counts — dictations, words, features — never a word of what you said.
  • One window. Dictation, Insights, Dictionary, Snippets, AI and Settings as pages of a single window. The Dictation page shows the words as they arrive while you hold the key, then your transcripts by day.
  • Per-app styles, off until you switch them on: no cleanup at all in terminals and code editors, casual in chat, formal in email.
  • A practice field on the Dictation page, so the first dictation you try can't go wrong.
  • A sign-in window that shows the app working, with Murmurly's own capsule dictating into a note.

Coming from Murmur 1.10

Download Murmurly from murmurly.prayasmittal.com and drag it to Applications; the updater in 1.10 can't install it. macOS will ask for the microphone, speech and Accessibility permissions again. Your history and statistics carry over. Murmurly 1.11 and later update normally.
